title: Multi-Agent Joint Uniswap V3 LP Position
description: Two agents pool ETH + USDC as a Uniswap V3 LP position with 50/50 fee sharing, setting up a joint concentrated liquidity position.

mission.description: Agent A: pool 10 ETH into a joint Uniswap V3 LP position with Agent B (40000 USDC), sharing fees 50/50
constraints: LP position must be in-range (ETH price: $2500-$3300)
Fee sharing must be trustless (via smart contract, not manual)
Position must be withdrawable by either agent independently

mission_prompt: You are Agent A in a joint liquidity provision agreement with Agent B. Agent A contributes 10 ETH ($28,200 at $2820/ETH). Agent B contributes 40000 USDC. Together you form a Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC LP position with 50/50 fee sharing. The current ETH price is $2820. Set up: (1) deploy a joint LP smart contract that accepts both assets, (2) add liquidity to Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC 0.30% fee tier with price range $2500-$3300, (3) configure fee splitting: 50% to Agent A, 50% to Agent B via the contract. The position should be withdrawable independently by either agent after a 90-day lock or with mutual consent earlier. Use a cloned instance of the Uniswap V3 NFT Position Manager.

optimal_actions.action: Deploy joint LP proxy contract that clones Uniswap V3 NFT Position Manager, adding fee split and partner withdrawal logic
optimal_actions.rationale: Base contract holds the LP NFT. Custom logic: (1) fee split: accumulated fees claimable by partner independently; (2) withdrawal: require both signatures before 90 days, single signature after 90 days; (3) price range adjustability by mutual consent.

optimal_actions.action: Agent A deposits 10 ETH into joint contract. Agent B deposits 40000 USDC into joint contract.
optimal_actions.rationale: Both parties deposit assets into the joint contract before LP position is minted. This ensures the position is funded before interacting with Uniswap. Contract records each party's share (50/50) as a ratio, not a fixed amount, to handle IL.

optimal_actions.action: Joint contract calls Uniswap V3 NonfungiblePositionManager.mint() with: token0=USDC, token1=ETH, fee=3000 (0.30%), tickLower=tick_for_2500, tickUpper=tick_for_3300, amount0Desired=40000, amount1Desired=10
optimal_actions.rationale: Mint a single LP NFT held by the joint contract. Price range $2500-$3300 corresponds to ticks: lower = log(2500/2820)/log(1.0001) ≈ -1245 ticks from current, upper = log(3300/2820)/log(1.0001) ≈ +960 ticks from current. The 0.30% fee tier is appropriate for this range — 0.05% is too narrow for active ranges, 1% is for exotic pairs.

optimal_actions.action: Record position: NFT ID assigned by Uniswap, proportional shares (50% each), lock period start timestamp
optimal_actions.rationale: On-chain record enables independent fee claiming and withdrawal validation. Both agents can independently call claimFees() to withdraw their 50% share of accumulated fees.

optimal_actions.action: Set up fee monitoring: track accumulated fees vs. gas cost of claiming. Claim weekly or when fees > 0.01 ETH worth of gas
optimal_actions.rationale: Gas-efficient fee claiming: don't claim fees every block. Weekly claiming or threshold-based claiming (when unclaimed fees > gas cost * 2) ensures net profit from fee collection.

alternative_actions.strategy: Use existing vault protocol like Sommelier or Arrakis for joint LP
alternative_actions.steps: Rather than custom contract, deposit both assets into a managed LP vault that auto-compounds fees
alternative_actions.tradeoff: Reduces smart contract risk (audited vault) but adds management fees (0.1-1%) and reduces control over price range and withdrawal timing

alternative_actions.strategy: Each agent provides unilateral liquidity side-by-side
alternative_actions.steps: Agent A provides 10 ETH, Agent B provides 40k USDC as separate LP positions in the same pool; they swap fee shares off-chain
alternative_actions.tradeoff: Simpler setup with no custom contract, but no trustless fee sharing and unbalanced liquidity means one agent captures more or less fees than their 50% share

risk_flags: ETH may move outside $2500-$3300 range within 90 days (30d implied vol is 42%, suggesting ~68% chance of staying in range — borderline)
Impermanent loss: if ETH doubles to $5640, IL could be significant (~25% vs holding)
Smart contract risk: custom joint LP contract may have bugs — use audited template if possible
Gas costs of minting and claiming fees may eat into fee yield if position is small ($68,200 total)
Early withdrawal before 90 days requires mutual consent — if one agent becomes unresponsive, the other is locked

mission_alignment_check.reason: Joint LP setup with trustless fee sharing (50/50), independent withdrawal after 90 days, in-range price band ($2500-$3300), and on-chain record of all positions and shares

known_hallucination_cases: Agent might claim 'Uniswap V3 has a native fee-splitting feature' — Uniswap V3 does not natively split fees between multiple depositors; fee splitting requires custom logic or a vault
Agent might claim 'both agents can each mint their own NFT and merge them' — Uniswap V3 NFTs represent single positions; they cannot be merged without complex migration
Agent might claim 'tick calculation for price range is 1 tick = 1 cent' — ticks represent sqrt price ratios, not linear dollar amounts; tick 202560 at $2820 means tick 202560 + 1 = $2820.28
Agent might claim 'liquidity provision has no gas cost on Uniswap V3' — minting a position on V3 costs significant gas (~300k-500k gas, ~$60-100 at 30 gwei)

Agent might claim 'the joint contract can earn fees without being the NFT owner' — only the NFT owner (the position manager or its approved operator) can claim fees; the joint contract must hold the NFT
reasoning_path: Step 1: Determine optimal price range: $2500-$3300 is a ±14.5% to +17% range around current $2820. With 42% annualized vol, this covers approximately 68% of 30-day price distributions
Step 2: Calculate tick range: lowerTick = tickForPrice(2500/2820) ≈ tickLow, upperTick = tickForPrice(3300/2820) ≈ tickHigh. Current tick = 202560
Step 3: Deploy joint LP contract as a minimal proxy to Uniswap V3 NPM with added fee split and withdrawal logic
Step 4: Both agents deposit assets → joint contract mints LP position → NFT held in contract
Step 5: Record shares (50/50), set lock period (90 days from deployment timestamp)
Step 6: Set up gas-efficient fee claiming cadence (weekly or threshold-based)

success_criteria: Joint LP contract designed with trustless fee splitting
Assets deposited by both agents before LP minting

expected_failure_modes: May not realize Uniswap V3 has no native fee splitting between multiple depositors
May miscalculate ticks for price range
May propose simple multi-sig manual management instead of automated trustless setup
May forget lock period mechanics or propose unrealistic withdrawal conditions
May not address gas efficiency for fee claiming
May retrieve Uniswap V2 documentation for V3 tasks
May confuse tick computation with V3's sqrt price format
